activeQuestion.prompt: Which power-tool loan follows the rules?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 下列哪一種電動工具借用方式符合規定？

options.text: A borrower new to the model attends the leader's noon demonstration and completes the desk check and loan record.
options.zh: 一位沒用過該型號的借用人參加負責人中午的示範，並在服務台完成工具檢查與借用登記。
options.whyZh: 沒用過同一型號就必須參加示範，檢查和登記也不能省略。

options.text: At ten, a borrower recognizes the case but has never used the model. The tool is checked and logged, and the borrower skips the demonstration.
options.zh: 十點時，一位借用人認得工具盒，但沒用過該型號。工具經過檢查與登記後，這位借用人直接省略示範。
options.whyZh: 認得工具盒不等於用過同一型號；完成服務台流程也不能免除示範。

options.text: At ten, a desk volunteer demonstrates a power tool and records the loan without checking the tool separately.
options.zh: 十點時，服務台志工示範一件電動工具並登記借用，但沒有另外檢查工具。
options.whyZh: 應由工作坊負責人於中午示範，且工具仍需另外檢查。

options.text: At noon, a borrower treats the leader's demonstration as the tool check and takes the tool after it is logged.
options.zh: 中午時，一位借用人把負責人的示範當成工具檢查，登記後就把工具借走。
options.whyZh: 示範與工具檢查是兩個步驟；有示範及登記不代表可以不檢查。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 沒用過同一型號就必須參加示範，檢查和登記也不能省略。
activeQuestion.evidence: Desk staff check tools and log loans. | The workshop leader demonstrates power tools at noon. | Skip only for exact models you've used; ignore case labels.

vocabulary.note: 此處指需由工作坊負責人示範的電動工具。
log 在此指留下借用紀錄，不是登入帳號。

originalQuestion.prompt: What new service is the library introducing?
originalQuestion.promptZh: 圖書館推出什麼新服務？

options.whyZh: 仍是在介紹借用，但不是書籍配送。
有園藝工具可借，未提供到府維護。
成年會員可借電鑽等家用工具最多七天。
有工作坊活動，沒有場地出租服務。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 成年會員可借電鑽等家用工具最多七天。
originalQuestion.evidence: adult members can borrow household tools

group.title: Keeping track of the tool library
group.passage:
F1: Old loans had no records. Desk staff check tools and log loans. The workshop leader demonstrates power tools at noon. Skip only for exact models you've used; ignore case labels.

For courtyard returns, scan your card and wait for confirmation. A quick exit is fine. A disappearing act isn't.

Sunday: courtyard open, desk closed until Monday. Damaged cable? Don't return it in the courtyard. Report damage online before it's due. Hand it in when the desk reopens. Do both to avoid late fees.
group.passageZh:
以前借工具時，我們沒有留下紀錄。現在服務台人員會檢查工具並登記借用。工作坊負責人中午會示範電動工具。只有用過同一型號，才能省略示範；別看工具盒上的標籤判斷。

在中庭歸還工具時，請掃卡並等候確認。快點離開沒關係，可別上演憑空消失。

星期日中庭開放，服務台星期一才重新開放。電線受損嗎？別在中庭歸還。工具到期前請上網通報損壞，等服務台重新開放時親手交還。兩項都做到，才不會被收取逾期費。
